description: Use this when a seller asks which print-on-demand suppliers POD Benchmark covers, or needs a supplier id for get_supplier, get_supplier_prices or compare_product. Returns each supplier's id, name, whether it prints orders itself or routes them to print providers, its website and its POD Benchmark profile. Filter by name with query.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

query.description: Words in the supplier name, such as `print`. Leave empty for all.

name: list_suppliers

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

id.description: The supplier's id, to pass to get_supplier, get_supplier_prices or compare_product.

type.description: direct when the supplier makes and ships orders itself, marketplace when it routes them to independent print providers; null when unknown.

url.description: The supplier's profile page on POD Benchmark; null when it has none.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: List suppliers
